articles.summary: Church Dwight Co., Inc. (NYSE: CHD) has signed a definitive agreement to acquire 45% of the shares of BALI Treatment GmbH, a rapidly growing hair care and styling company in Europe that includes the BALI CURLS™ and BALI GENTS™ brands, for approximately $225 million. The brands have established market leading positions in Germany and Austria with expansion across Europe now underway. The company reported net sales for the twelve months ended October 31, 2026, of approximately $100 million. Church Dwight will have the option to acquire the remaining 55% of the company’s shares beginning two years after closing, subject to the terms of the agreement. The Bali Care business was founded in 2022 by Hendrik Genotte to create high-quality hair care and styling products designed around the needs of consumers with curly and textured hair.
